# SSL

This mod adds SSL capabilities to code-server.

Add it to the `code-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-ssl
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-ssl|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

You will also need to set the variables `SSL_CERT_PATH` and `SSL_KEY_PATH`.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/code-server-ssl/
